g.text: M3c current run stop, native join and Host-owned disposal
copy input / retain handle / root callback context
unregister token / release context and extra handle reference
canceled, or termination error if stop failed
retain context and handle reference until process exit
close arbitration / await token callbacks / dispose timer and CTS
Canceled or TimedOut; termination error overrides as Faulted
Host shutdown closes admission and requests Shutdown before waiting.
It also stops automatic scheduling and awaits auto session cleanup.
Persistence already entered must finish saving.
Unconfirmed Wait completion means managed failure arbitration, not native termination.
